app_info.subtitle: Find real UGC creators (DACH)
app_info.description: UGC VZ is a free directory of real, verified UGC creators in the German-speaking region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) with portfolio and social-media proof - no AI-avatar content. Brands search the directory by free-text query, city, topics, or verification level, inspect individual creator profiles, and deliberately request contact. UGC VZ then delivers the creators' contact details to the brand by e-mail; the directory takes no commission. Typical workflow: search creators, review a profile, trigger an outreach request, and poll its delivery status. Creator search and profile data never expose private contact details inside ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only queries the UGC VZ creator database and returns matching public profiles without creating or updating any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from UGC VZ's own private database and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the public profile of a single creator by ID and never modifies data or exposes private contact details.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from UGC VZ's own private database and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new outreach request in UGC VZ's system and triggers a real e-mail delivering creator contact details to the requesting brand.
justifications.open_world_justification: Triggers real e-mail delivery outside the closed system, addressed to the brand e-mail supplied by the caller.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new outreach request and sends a notification; it does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the lifecycle status (submitted, working, completed, failed) of an existing outreach request without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads request state from UGC VZ's own private database and does not touch external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns aggregated vocabulary (topics, industries, cities, verification-level definitions) derived from active profiles.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads aggregated data from UGC VZ's own private database and does not touch external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Free-text creator search for a campaign brief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find me UGC creators in Berlin who could shoot a TikTok product video for a fitness brand.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a list of matching public creator profiles (name, city, topics, verification level) without any private contact details.

test_cases.description: Inspect a single creator from a previous search result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me more details about the second creator from that search.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the full public profile (topics, industries, equipment, portfolio links, social accounts, fee and reach text) for the given creator_public_id, still without private contact data.

test_cases.description: Deliberate brand outreach after reviewing profiles.
test_cases.user_prompt: Please request contact details for these two creators. My name is Jane Doe and my company e-mail is jane@brand.example.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates an outreach request and returns a request_id; the model explains that UGC VZ will deliver the creators' contact details to the given brand e-mail.

test_cases.description: Poll the delivery status of an outreach request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Has my creator contact request gone through yet?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current lifecycle status (submitted, working, completed, or failed) with timestamps for the stored request_id.

test_cases.description: Discover valid filter values before a first search.
test_cases.user_prompt: What topics and cities can I filter UGC VZ creators by, and what do the verification levels mean?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current vocabulary of topics, industries, and cities plus the definition of the human_verification levels and a pricing note.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general influencer-marketing advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What's a good briefing template for working with influencers?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; this is general marketing advice with no creator search or outreach intent.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for creator searches outside the DACH region.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me UGC creators in Los Angeles for an English-language campaign.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked or should clarify that UGC VZ only lists creators in the German-speaking region (DACH).

negative_test_cases.description: Do not send outreach without an explicit, serious brand request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Just test the contact request feature with some fake data.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: request_outreach must not be called; the terms of use forbid test calls and bulk requests, and name/e-mail must belong to the real requesting brand.
